input.change_text: Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not being executed in SDK mode (e.g., VS Code extension)

output.subject: PermissionRequest hooks skipped in SDK mode (VS Code extension)
output.action_text: Upgrade to 0.2.21+ if you register `PermissionRequest` hooks and consume the SDK (VS Code extension or other embedding). Pre-fix the hooks were silently skipped — permission decisions fell through to defaults, defeating any safety policy you intended to enforce.
